name: WestGold Metals Corp.
summary: WestGold Metals Corp. is an enterprise dedicated to the discovery, evaluation, and development of mineral resources. Its operations span multiple regions, including Brazil, Ontario, Quebec, Newfoundland, and other international sites. The company primarily targets gold and lithium deposits. A key asset in its portfolio is the Isoneva Gold Project, situated within the Western Finland Gold Belt in central Finland. Founded in 2018, the company is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada. It previously operated under the name Nordique Resources Inc. before rebranding as WestGold Metals Corp. in April 2026.
